title: File:Afghanistan-Iran border in Zaranj, Afghanistan, 2011.jpg
art: Sgt. Mallory S. VanderSchans, U.S. Marine Corps
desc: Trucks wait to cross the Afghanistan-Iran border in Zaranj, Afghanistan, May 10, 2011. The crossing is part of a busy trade route between Central Asia and the Middle East.
